div.l: A sheff of pekoc arwes / bryht and shene
Vndyr his belte / he bar wel thryftyly
Wel cowde he dresse / his takel yemanly
His arwes drouped nowht / with fetheres lowe
And in his honde he bar / a myhty bowe
A not hed he hadde / with a brown visage
Of wode craft / wel cowde he al the vsage
Vp on his arme / he bar a gay braceer
And bi his syde / a swerd and a bokeleer
And on that other syde / a gay dagger
Harneysed wel / and sharpe as poynt of spere
A cristofre on his brest / of syluer shene
An horn he bare / the bawdryk was of grene
A foster was he / sothly as I gesse
THere was also / a Nonne a Prioresse
That of here smylyng / was wel symple and coy
Hir grettest oth was but bi seynt loy
And she was cleped / madame Eglentyne
Ful wel she song / the ʆseruice diuine
Entewned in here / nose ful swetely
And frensh she spak / wel fayr and fetisly
Aftyr the scole / of stratforde atte bowe
For frensh of parys / was to here vnknowe
At mete wel I tawht / was she with alle
She lete no mussel / from hir lippes falle
Ne wete hir fyngres / in hir sauce depe
Wele cowde she carye / a morsel and wel kepe
That no drope / falle on here brest
In curteysye was set / wol moche here lyste
Here over lippe / wyped she so clene
That in here cuppe / ther was no ferthyng sene
Of grece / whan she hadde dronke here drawht
Vol semely / aftyr here mete she rawht
And sekerly / she was of gret disport
And wel plesawnt / and amyable of port
